title: Confirmed service coverage for Stop
purpose: Provide a distinct single-request confirmed-service seed centered on the documented Stop service tag to add program-invocation control coverage without duplicating prior generic confirmed-request shapes.
expected_behavior: The parser should accept the RFC1006/COTP-wrapped MMS confirmed request and dispatch it to the Stop confirmed-service handler or corresponding service-choice parser path.
constraints_preserved: For MMS over RFC1006, prefer a TPKT header beginning with version 0x03.
Keep the TPKT total-length field consistent with the complete message.
Use documented MMS PDU type tag 0xA0 for confirmed request and service tag value [41] for Stop.
issue_safety_notes: No issue motif is exercised here beyond standard framing. The seed is intentionally compact, valid, and avoids malformed lengths, oversized allocations, or invalid COTP option values.
